behaviors.preconditions: Environment control returns exact inherited sentinel.
behaviors.expected: Unset option makes probe report missing variable.

behaviors.description: Grant and revoke access to host build input.
behaviors.preconditions: Host marker outside default sandbox access.
behaviors.expected: Control denied, explicit grant reads marker, explicit denial defeats grant.

behaviors.description: Prevent modifications to app build destination independently of the var contract.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent initialized tree with known app artifact and installed SDK.
behaviors.expected: A control write without --readonly persists. With --readonly, the artifact is readable, writing fails and original app artifact bytes survive.

behaviors.description: Persist /app, /var/lib and /var/tmp artifacts using the SDK probe.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent initialized tree and installed SDK with file-capable probe.
behaviors.expected: Writes reach files, var/lib and var/tmp and survive later build commands; a /var/artifact write neither reaches the build tree nor survives another command.

behaviors.description: Prevent modifications to /app and a local SDK at /usr while /var/lib and /var/tmp remain writable under --readonly.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent initialized tree with known artifacts in files, selected-sdk, var/lib and var/tmp; local SDK selected with --sdk-dir.
behaviors.expected: Control writes without --readonly persist at each destination. With --readonly, each artifact is readable. Writes to /app and /usr fail and their original host bytes survive; writes to /var/lib and /var/tmp succeed, update the host files and survive another build command.

behaviors.description: Select build bind mount, working directory and environment.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent initialized tree, installed SDK and host marker.
behaviors.expected: Relative read reaches bound marker and environment query equals requested value.

behaviors.description: Select non-devel runtime instead of missing SDK.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent tree names unavailable SDK but available runtime.
behaviors.expected: Default build fails identifying SDK; --runtime executes runtime probe.

behaviors.preconditions: Default metadata names missing SDK; alternate metadata names installed SDK.
behaviors.expected: Default command fails; alternate metadata command runs probe.

behaviors.description: Select independently copied custom SDK tree.
behaviors.preconditions: Default SDK lacks marker; custom SDK contains it.
behaviors.expected: Default read fails, custom SDK read yields marker.

mappings.rationale: SDK executable writes /app, /var/lib and /var/tmp, host checks verify the build tree bytes, and subsequent commands read them back. A /var/artifact write does not persist.

Writable controls persist at every destination. Readonly commands read each seeded marker, reject writes through /app and local /usr without changing their host files, and persist writes through /var/lib and /var/tmp in the host files and later commands.
